description: Zero-dependency, tree-shakeable utils for Brazilian-specific businesses: CPF, CNPJ, boleto, Pix, CEP, holidays and more.
rules: The package has zero runtime dependencies and ships as ESM with a UMD build; nothing else needs to be installed to use it.

Import from the package root: import { isValidCpf } from '@brazilian-utils/brazilian-utils'. Every util is also a subpath, '@brazilian-utils/brazilian-utils/<util-name>' in kebab-case (isValidCpf -> is-valid-cpf), meant for lazy-loading the dataset-backed utils (getCities, getMunicipality*, getCnae, getCfop, getBanks...). Never import the same util from both the root and its subpath in one app: the dataset is bundled twice.

Document validators such as isValidCpf and isValidCnpj accept the usual mask characters and whitespace, so there is no need to strip formatting before calling them; formatters (format*) return the masked string.
Every util is synchronous and pure except getAddressInfoByCep and getCepInfoByAddress, which are async and query public CEP APIs over HTTPS.
Supported runtimes: Node.js ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0, Bun, Deno and evergreen browsers.
